cases.name: run-notes take: a pending note of the batch printed once, another batch's left, nothing printed the second time
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/pane-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/todo/x/run && cd $R && W=$R/todo/x/run/.work.jsonl && printf '# Plan
' > todo/x/X-PLAN.md && printf '# X F3

## Cycles

```json
{"cycles": [{"id": "C1", "behaviour": "Archive a product", "decisions": ""}, {"id": "C2", "behaviour": "List archived", "decisions": ""}]}
```

## Assumptions <!-- kit:assumptions -->

| # | Assumption | To be validated by |
|---|------------|--------------------|
| H1 | a | b |
' > todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md && printf '{"kind":"note","id":"n1","batch":"F3","text":"keep the old route","at":1}
{"kind":"note","id":"n2","batch":"F4","text":"later","at":2}
' > todo/x/run/.pane.jsonl && a=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-notes.py take $W F3) && b=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-notes.py take $W F3) && echo "[$a][$b]$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-notes.py take $W F4 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

expect.stdout: [Note from the user for F3: keep the old route][]1

cases.name: run-validate apply: reject writes the decision into the named cycle and an Hn marked user decision, keep changes nothing, each applied once, relaunch printed
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/pane-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/todo/x/run && cd $R && W=$R/todo/x/run/.work.jsonl && printf '# Plan
' > todo/x/X-PLAN.md && printf '# X F3

## Cycles

```json
{"cycles": [{"id": "C1", "behaviour": "Archive a product", "decisions": ""}, {"id": "C2", "behaviour": "List archived", "decisions": ""}]}
```

## Assumptions <!-- kit:assumptions -->

| # | Assumption | To be validated by |
|---|------------|--------------------|
| H1 | a | b |
' > todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md && printf '{"kind":"validation","id":"v1","entry":{"batch":"F3","step":"GREEN Archive a product","text":"tests modified at GREEN"},"decision":"reject","text":"restore the test, fix production","at":1}
{"kind":"validation","id":"v2","entry":{"batch":"F3","step":"Design","text":"choice x"},"decision":"keep","text":"","at":1}
' > todo/x/run/.pane.jsonl && out=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-validate.py apply $W | tr '
' ';') && again=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-validate.py apply $W) && echo "$out[$again]$(grep -c 'restore the test, fix production' todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md)|$(grep -o '| H2 | rejected: tests modified at GREEN → restore the test, fix production | user decision |' todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md)" && echo "[$again]$(grep -c 'restore the test, fix production' todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md)|$(grep -o '| H2 | rejected: tests modified at GREEN → restore the test, fix production | user decision |' todo/x/X-PLAN-F3.md)|$out"
